    f"y_pred = {r(v1)} * ReLU({r(w1)} * x + {r(b1)}) "
    f"+ {r(v2)} * ReLU({r(w2)} * x + {r(b2)}) + {r(c)}"
)
print("\nTrained equation with weights/biases baked in:")
